value.rationale: At the mathematically natural -1 spectral boundary of a named three-dimensional sine map, strict linear stability no longer decides attraction. The result resolves a nonhyperbolic fixed point locally, separates exponentially decaying exceptional states from generic algebraic states, and provides the explicit parameter-dependent logarithmic coefficient beyond leading square-root relaxation. This is a structural and quantitative boundary theorem, not a routine numerical gain.
